generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a small understory tree with a rounded crown, opposite oval leaves with curving veins, and large white flower heads of four to six petal-like bracts. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 10 m tall and 20 cm across at breast height at 40 years in a closed stand. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: green leaves; white bracts round a greenish button; smooth grey-brown bark. Fruit (plant roadmap P4), as in mid-July: tight heads of green drupes that turn red in autumn. Its year (appearance.organs.bloom.season) is authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands: white bracts in April and May; the fruit heads green in summer, red in September and October. The forest's packages show day 196 (mid-July) until the phenology of plant roadmap P5 sets the day from the date and the local climate. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): smooth thin grey-brown bark becoming checkered into small plates; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.
